The passage R1-1703437-001 (36.213 series) lists "HARQ related procedures" as one item in section 4.2.4, and in 5.5 lists one HARQ-related bullet ("Physical uplink shared channel related procedures, including UE sounding and HARQ ACK/NACK detection"). R1-160247-002 also references TS 36.213 with one HARQ-related bullet. However, these passages describe LTE physical layer document structure but do not provide a clear, complete, unambiguous distribution count of HARQ-related sections across all TSs. The question asks for a distribution (scope of HARQ implementation) across the TSs, which would require a complete, verifiable population of specs and their HARQ section counts. The passages do not supply a well-defined, countable "sectionCount" of HARQ-related sections per TS in a way that supports a complete answer.
